notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other artifact.
Freed from the Real attached to Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Embraal Gear-Smasher does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Rukarumel.
description:
Activate Embraal Gear-Smasher by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage by Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Embraal Gear-Smasher.
Repeat.
